policy: Peak RSS is observable toolchain behavior. Native multi-unit check paths, host-wrapper tool installs, analyzer/formatter suites and build smokes are blocking unless marked otherwise.

small-source.description: Tiny single-file check; should stay far below a gigabyte after collect/tool setup.

medium-selfhost-module.description: Medium source or stdlib/selfhost-like module check.

import-heavy-batch.description: Import closure collection over a synthetic dependency fan-in.

analyzer-batch.description: Strict analyzer batch over representative analyzer fixtures.

analyzer-std-api-hash.description: Strict analyzer over one small std module, including public API signature hashing.

analyzer-bounded-tree.description: Strict analyzer over a production source tree with file-local process isolation. Peak is the wrapper plus the largest per-file native process; the analyze tree now includes unit/finding/drive. Host samples sit around 270-310k KiB.

analyzer-structured-large-guard.description: Oversized structured-analyzer inputs must fail before starting the native drive.

analyzer-drive-largest-file.description: All eighteen per-file structured families over the largest current production source, selected by the suite. The unchanged limit retains headroom from the pre-consolidation parser_parse.ouro baseline (about 3.03M KiB); that measurement is not a claim about the newly selected input.

analyzer-enable-all.description: An oversized all-family scope must fail before native analyzers start.

tool-emission-collect.description: On-demand collect tool install must not enter the multi-GiB selfhost emission path by default.

tool-emission-fmt.description: On-demand formatter install must remain bounded on small tool sources.

tool-emission-analyze.description: On-demand analyzer install must remain bounded on small tool sources.

formatter-suite.description: Formatter goldens, idempotence, write mode, and tree drift check.

strict-quality-gate.description: Release strict-quality firewall smoke with reports.

stage-loop-smoke.description: Representative C bootstrap build smoke used when a full stage loop is too expensive.

native-check-fmt.description: Native multi-unit compiler plus root-declaration check for tools/fmt. The compacted 24-byte cell and early reclamation of single-use closures/thunks brought host samples to about 0.59M KiB (was ~2.0M); the budget is that peak plus host slack.

native-check-analyze.description: Native multi-unit compiler plus root-declaration check for tools/analyze. The policy-core cone previously peaked around 4.56M KiB; with the compacted cell and reclaiming apply/case it now samples about 1.23M KiB here. The budget is that peak plus host slack, well under the old failure mode.

native-c-build-jobs2.description: Incremental C bootstrap build with two jobs.
